name: Yasukawa Kenzo
source: He's adored by students for his easy-going attitude. He never attends any meetings, but somehow always seems to be in the know. He secretly raises chickens in the Nurses' office. At school, he is the laid back nurse. But when you let your guard down, he might suddenly pull you in for a kiss!? You two may end up playing around quite a bit...
